title: Serve Data from the European Tracking Network
text: Etn provides functionality access data European Tracking Network (ETN) database hosted Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ) part Flemish contribution LifeWatch. ETN data subject ETN data policy can : restricted: moratorium accessible logged-data owners/collaborators unrestricted: publicly accessible without login routinely published international biodiversity facilities ETN infrastructure currently requires package run within LifeWatch.RStudio server, password protected. login can requested https://www.lifewatch./etn/contact.

title: Serve Data from the European Tracking Network

code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("inbo/etnservice") install.packages("etnservice", repos = c(inbo = "https://inbo.r-universe.dev"))

title: Serve Data from the European Tracking Network
text: basic example shows adress API directly: Tthe etn package uses package inner workings ’s functions. Another example request , now using curl:
code: library(httr2) # to talk to the internet library(magrittr) # to use pipes library(askpass) # to safly enter a password in R  # To access the ETN database, we need a login (username + password). We'll ask # for the password dynamically because that's safer than storing it as an object username <- "<your-username-here>" # All functions can be adressed directly in the URL endpoint <- "https://opencpu.lifewatch.be/library/etnservice/R/list_scientific_names" # Request the result of the function to be a json, and put in a request response <-     httr2::request(endpoint) %>%      ## In this case we'll request the data in JSON format and parse it     httr2::req_url_path_append("json") %>%     httr2::req_body_json(       list(credentials = list(username = username,                               password = askpass::askpass()))     ) %>%      httr2::req_perform() # Take the response of the server, and convert it into an R object we can use response %>%     httr2::resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE) #! /bin/bash curl --location 'https://opencpu.lifewatch.be/library/etnservice/R/list_scientific_names/json' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data-raw '{     "credentials": {         "username": "<your-username-here>",         "password": "<your-password-here>"     } }'

title: Transform ETN data to Darwin Core — write_dwc
text: Data transformed Occurrence core. follows recommendations discussed created Peter Desmet, Jonas Mortelmans, Jonathan Pye, John Wieczorek others. See SQL file(s) used function details. Key features Darwin Core transformation: Deployments (animal+tag associations) parent events, capture, surgery, release, recapture (human observations) acoustic detections (machine observations) child events. information parent event provided ID, meaning data can expressed Occurrence Core one row per observation parentEventID shared occurrences deployment. release event often contains metadata animal (sex, lifestage, comments) deployment whole. Acoustic detections downsampled first detection per hour, reduce size high-frequency data. Duplicate detections (animal, tag timestamp) excluded. possible deployment contain detections, e.g. tag malfunctioned right deployment.

title: etnservice 0.7.1
text: Fixed bug get_acoustic_detections_page() tag_serial_number argument cast character causing database errors. (#174)

title: etnservice 0.7.0
text: Added get_archival_data_uuid() fetches table UUID references archival data files. UUIDs can used construct paths download archival data CSV files hosted lifewatch.com (#126). function write_dwc() updated etn package longer needed etnservice. (#141) jsonlite package longer direct dependency, used maintenance script. (#144) etnservice now relies R >= 4.1.0 uses base pipes (|> rather %>%) (#151). function get_receiver_logs() renamed get_acoustic_deployment_logs() review process respective etn client function. get_acoustic_deployment_logs() also supports less arguments greatly simplified user interface. (#160) # etnservice 0.6.0 Added get_receiver_logs() fetch receiver logs database. data returned tibble column logs JSON format. (#117)

text: Made sure list_acoustic_project_codes(), list_animal_project_codes(), list_cpod_project_codes() list_scientific_names() always return values order, regardless locale computer R running . (#116)

text: Added tag_serial_number get_acoustic_detections_page(). argument better option acoustic_tag_id. Thank @lottepohl suggestion. (#112, inbo/etn#386, #102)

title: etnservice 0.4.3

title: etnservice 0.4.2

title: etnservice 0.4.1

title: etnservice 0.4.0
text: Added get_version() allows users easily compare locally installed version etnservice one deployed OpenCPU API. (#81) Added get_acoustic_detections_page() fetches single page new detections view. function allows paginated access called etn package function get_acoustic_detections() make fetching large numbers detections efficient. (#85) depth_in_meters field returned part get_acoustic_detections_page(), calculated field proved unreliable. also causing performance issues database. alternative depth can (sometimes) retrieved via sensor_value sensor_unit, dependable calculation based slope.

title: etnservice 0.3.0
